title: LogControl
body:
### LogControl
  
  The perfect plugin for survival server hosters who don't want to ruin the fun.

  ---
  Stop accidentally spoiling your players' secret bases, private conversations, and hidden treasures.

  As a server admin, your console reveals everything — coordinates where players die, teleport destinations, private messages, and more. LogControl gives you the power to keep the mystery alive while still maintaining full server control.

  ---
  Features

  Coordinate Redaction
  Hide all player coordinates from your console and log files. No more accidentally seeing where your players built their secret bases or hid their diamonds.

  Before: Player logged in at ([world]6.5, 122.0, -4.5)
  After:  Player logged in [REDACTED]

  Private Message Redaction
  Keep /msg, /tell, /whisper, and /r conversations private — even from you. Your players' secrets stay secret.

  Before: Player issued command: /tell Friend meet me at the base, password is 1234
  After:  Player issued command: [REDACTED]

  Spam Suppression
  Clean up your console by filtering out repetitive noise like "moved too quickly", connection throttle messages, and entity warnings. Focus on what matters.

  ---
  Configuration

  All features are independently toggleable and hot-reloadable:

  RedactCoords: true   (Hide coordinates)
  RedactMSG: true      (Hide private messages)  
  SuppressSpam: true   (Filter console spam)

  Commands:
  - /logcontrol reload — Reload config without restart

  ---
  Why LogControl?

  - Preserve the adventure — Don't spoil base locations or player secrets
  - Stay GDPR-friendly — Keep private communications private
  - Cleaner logs — Remove spam, keep important messages
  - Zero performance impact — Efficient regex-based filtering
  - Paper native — Built on Log4j2 for seamless integration
